card.name: News dateline and journal publication cues
card.fires_on: Words in news-release openings and bylines, such as 'online' or 'published' after 'study', 'Health' in a HealthDay dateline, and 'marketing' after 'Post'.

modes.label: Published online
modes.description: 'online' or 'published' in a phrase saying a study appeared in a journal.

modes.label: Dateline pieces
modes.description: Part of a news dateline, such as HealthDay, a city name or a year.

modes.label: Postmarketing
modes.description: 'marketing' after 'Post' in a label's adverse reaction section.
modes.example: 5.11 Bullous Pemphigoid Post<<marketing>> cases of bullous pemphigoid

card.plain: It marks the wording of news releases and journal announcements, such as where a study was published and the dateline.
